original_test_intent: Verify each SMBIOS Type 28 temperature-probe record has the approved identity, location/status, encoded thermal limits and nominal metadata and persists across reboot, while retaining mixed chassis fields pending owner disposition.
original_method: Resolve field ownership, collect complete Type 28 and approved companion structures on the verified SUT, normalize raw temperature/accuracy/resolution/tolerance encodings and special values against the sensor map, reboot once with approval and compare persistence without changing thermal controls.
manual_activity: The owner maps mixed fields, supplies the exact temperature-probe population and encoding/limit expectations, and approves reboot/recovery; automation then performs non-mutating comparison.
required_inputs: Expected probe handles/count, descriptions, physical locations and statuses
Expected min/max/nominal temperature, resolution, tolerance, accuracy and OEM values
Raw unit/scale, sentinel, unknown/unpopulated and optional-probe rules
Type 27 cooling-device references to Type 28 handles where used
Approved reboot, workload window, protected evidence and independent recovery
safety_requirements: Do not treat copied chassis fields as Type 28 or silently discard them
Keep collection read-only; never alter fan policy, thresholds, thermal controls, firmware or SMBIOS
Preserve dmesg, syslog and SEL; no log clearing
Reject unit/scale confusion, invalid min/max/nominal relations, duplicate handles/locations or orphan Type 27 references
Require reboot approval and stop on thermal anomaly, wrong target or failed recovery
No automatic retry or inferred sensor mapping
agent_execution_scope: Record conflict and verify field/probe mapping
Collect complete Type 28, relevant Type 27 and approved companion structures
Normalize raw encodings and validate per-probe identity, range and reference invariants
Compare same-target structures before/after approved reboot
Make no thermal mutation, source rewrite, retry or PASS/FAIL verdict
engineer_actions: Map source fields to authoritative structures or approve defect disposition
Approve probe population, encodings, Type 27 references and reboot/recovery
Review missing/duplicate/range/reference/persistence deviations and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build one normalized record per Type 28 handle with raw encoding, identity/location/status and engineering metadata; reconcile Type 27 references and compare the complete approved population across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds handle/reference and encoding semantics while rejecting header-only evidence, log clearing and thermal-control changes.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A heading cannot expose missing/duplicate handles, wrong location, invalid status, bad scale or inconsistent min/max/nominal/resolution/tolerance/accuracy values.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SMBIOS temperature-probe metadata does not prove live sensor accuracy or cooling response; those require independent runtime/physical validation.

project_override_considerations: Optional probes, unknown encodings and Type 27 reference exceptions must be versioned for exact platform/BIOS identity; companion-field removal requires explicit governance.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and owner field-to-structure disposition
Approved Type 28 probe/encoding matrix, Type 27 references and any companion matrices
Complete pre/post raw Type 28 plus relevant Type 27 records
Population, handle/reference, identity, status, range/precision and persistence results
Preserved logs, no thermal/fan write, reboot timeline, no-auto-retry audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Type 28 item/command target temperature-probe metadata, but the Procedure also names Manufacturer, Chassis Type/Status, Version, Serial, Asset Tag and Security fields from other structures without defining their ownership.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review and conflict recording are complete. Execution waits for field mapping, probe matrix and reboot approval; subsequent review proceeds.

review_improvement: Preserves every source field and adds encoding, handle/reference, population and thermal-limit invariants without manipulating the cooling system.
independent_technical_reasoning: Temperature fields use encoded units and special unknown values, so printed equality can hide raw representation errors or misread an unknown sentinel as zero. Type 28 handles may also be referenced by Type 27 cooling devices; a valid-looking probe that is duplicated or orphaned breaks declared topology. Complete raw-plus-normalized, cross-structure comparison is required, while live sensor accuracy remains outside this metadata testcase.
